sources: cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for all 95 Arkansas Point sites (parkID 50036), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails for every Arkansas Point site (93 'Electricity Hookup 50', 2 ADA '20/30/50'; no Water or Sewer Hookup on any) + 2024 brochure ('All campsites in the Arkansas Point Campground ... feature 50amp electrical hook-ups, centrally located water hydrants'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 95 electric sites (2 ADA): 38 pull-throughs and 57 back-ins, vehicle lengths 25-112 ft (most back-ins 35-45, pull-throughs 50-112).

sites.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails for all 95 Arkansas Point sites (site type, Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: 2024 brochure ('All campsites in the Arkansas Point Campground ... feature 50amp electrical hook-ups, centrally located water hydrants, flush toilets, and showers'; 'Dump stations are located in the Northern Plains and Arkansas Point campgrounds'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Limited sites and amenities in winter; cpwshop sells most Arkansas Point sites through the winter (Northern Plains closes).

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lake-pueblo-state-park/lake-pueblo-state-park-camping-lodging ('Open year-round, Lake Pueblo's campgrounds ...'; 'Camping is available year-round'; 'All Northern Plains Campgrounds are CLOSED for the winter season') + brochure ('Limited sites and amenities are available during the Winter season') + cpwshop availability grids (sites 015, 040, 065 bookable Nov 2026 - Apr 2027; site 001 not), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com, 1-800-244-5613, or at the park office during office hours (after hours by phone or online), up to six months ahead and on the day of arrival if sites are left. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lake-pueblo-state-park/lake-pueblo-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Lake Pueblo State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613 ... at the park office ... up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period') + brochure ('Reservations can be made from the time you arrive at the park (if sites are available) up to six months in advance'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Every Arkansas Point site is electric: $36 a night, Saturday the same. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a vehicle pass ($4 a day to $80 a year per CPW's park page) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/lake-pueblo-state-park/lake-pueblo-state-park-camping-lodging (Campsite 'Single campsite (max 6 occupants) 1 Night $28 - $36'; Park Pass '1 Day - 1 year $4 - $80'; 'Visitors are required to display a vehicle pass and have a valid reservation') + co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop June 15 and Sat June 19, 2027: Arkansas Point Electric '$36.00'), read 2026-10-27

note: South-side campground on the Arkansas Point ridge above Pueblo Reservoir. West-side Loop B sites overlook the reservoir from the elevated Arkansas Point bench per CPW campground map ('Nice View of Lake'); no beach at the loops (lakeview). --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + 2024 brochure + every cpwshop Arkansas Point site page: confirmed 95 sites, 50-amp electric, pull-throughs, year-round (limited in winter), showers/water/dump, reservation-only on cpwshop. Added no water/sewer at sites, max 112 ft, flush toilets, deep link/window/fcfs never/14-night max. Fees confirmed ($36 electric); fee note now names the per-stay reservation fee and the $4-$80 vehicle pass. Note trimmed of field restatements, 'Camp Colorado' and the RV Life line.
flags: Other campground with no entry: Juniper Breaks Campground (north side, ~2.4 km from the Northern Plains pin; cpwshop sells 84 basic sites, vehicles 30-65 ft, no electricity, water hydrants and vault toilets per the brochure, open in winter). A drive-in RV campground separate from both Arkansas Point and Northern Plains; candidate for its own entry (centroid 38.27688,-104.75341).
Pin is 294 m from the centroid of the 95 Arkansas Point sites (38.25156,-104.73264); fine.
Open now (Northern Plains is closed for the winter, Arkansas Point is not).
